name: com.doinglab.foodlens.sdk.ui.provider.FoodLensProvider
description: At app startup, DoingLab FoodLens saves shared app information used by its screens and clears leftover scan images from earlier sessions. This prepares image and resource access for the SDK's UI.
disableEffect: FoodLens screens may fail when they need this saved information, and old scan images will not be cleaned up.
